Hi Sana — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary of outcome
- Primary use case: clinical notes summarization + anonymized embeddings for search across patient records.
- Key constraints: SOC 2 evidence needed, VPC option for PHI, and predictability at 200 TPS during business hours.

Mutual action plan (attached: OrbitalHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx)
1) Security: Redwood to share SOC 2 report + architecture diagram (I attached the one-pager).
2) Pilot scope: 2-week pilot processing de-identified notes (POC dataset) — Redwood provides dedicated inference queue and monitoring dashboard.
3) Commercials: pilot at a discounted testing rate; production pricing to be captured in the contract after pilot.
4) Timeline: aim to kick off pilot week of Mar 14 if Orbital confirms by Mar 8.

Proposed owners & next steps
- You: share any procurement or compliance contacts for evidence review (cc'd procurement@orbitalhealth.com OK).
- Me: I'll get SOC 2 package + one-pager and calendar invite for a quick pilot runbook session.

Scheduling: Here is my calendar — https://calendly.com/ben-redwood/30 — if Mar 9–11 works I can lock in a 30m to finalize the MAP.

Attachments: OrbitalHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx, Redwood-OnePager.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to a pilot.

Best,
